confidence_notes: Model-knowledge estimate: remembered 2024-2025 Lima price levels brought forward to July 2026. No live listings or city-price web sources were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable. Hostel and hotel rates vary by district, season and holidays (for example Fiestas Patrias in late July), so the 3-star and private-room values are least certain. The cocktail (pisco sour) and wine-by-the-glass anchors were set from remembered Lima bar prices and cross-checked against the beer anchor at about 2.2-2.3 times beer. USD values assume roughly 3.5 soles per USD from memory, not verified for July 2026. The FX observation came from search results for the RBA exchange-rates page, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: No city-specific web source used. Regional basis: Andean capitals such as Bogota and Quito were the closest comparables for budget and mid-range levels, and Miraflores and San Isidro tourist supply was the reference for hostel and hotel rates.
